mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_index_aggregate_version(aggregate_key,current_version) VALUES(#{aggregateKey},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_version=current_version+1
mapper.select: SELECT current_version FROM t_index_aggregate_version WHERE aggregate_key=#{aggregateKey}

SELECT o.* FROM t_index_outbox o WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND o.next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_index_outbox older WHERE older.aggregate_key=o.aggregate_key AND older.object_version<o.object_version AND older.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{workerId},locked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_json=CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON),last_error=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='DEAD',last_error=#{error},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=CONCAT('Recovered stale lock; ',COALESCE(last_error,'')) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<#{threshold}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_index_delivery_attempt(event_id,attempt_no,status,duration_ms,response_json,error_text) VALUES(#{eventId},#{attemptNo},#{status},#{durationMs},CASE WHEN #{responseJson} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{responseJson} AS JSON) END,#{errorText})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status=#{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(status='PENDING') pending, SUM(status='PROCESSING') processing, SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount, SUM(status='SUCCEEDED') succeeded, SUM(status='DEAD') dead, SUM(status='SKIPPED') skipped, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,processed_time=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY')
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SKIPPED',locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY','PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE')) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE'))

SELECT cu.id content_unit_id,cu.page_no,cu.heading_path,cu.content,cu.content_hash, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.content_unit_id=cu.id ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidence_code, cu.content_hash evidence_hash FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY cu.id

SELECT SUM(status='PENDING') pending,SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount,SUM(status='DEAD') dead, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM t_index_delivery_attempt a JOIN t_index_outbox_archive o ON o.event_id=a.event_id WHERE o.processed_time<#{cutoff}

DELETE FROM t_index_outbox WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT o.id FROM t_index_outbox o JOIN t_index_outbox_archive a ON a.id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') AND o.processed_time<#{cutoff} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}) x)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_index_schema_release WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET state=#{state},elasticsearch_count=#{elasticsearchCount},milvus_count=#{milvusCount},elasticsearch_target=#{elasticsearchTarget},milvus_target=#{milvusTarget},validation_json=CASE WHEN #{validationJson} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{validationJson} AS JSON) END,error_text=#{errorText} WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}

UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET state=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN state='ACTIVE' THEN 'RETIRED' ELSE state END, activated_time=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE activated_time END,retired_time=CASE WHEN state='ACTIVE' AND release_id<>#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE retired_time END WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (release_id=#{releaseId} OR state='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('CONTENT_UNIT:',cu.id) objectKey,CAST(cu.id AS CHAR) objectId,'CONTENT_UNIT' objectType, s.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,d.id documentId,cu.id contentUnitId, COALESCE(cu.heading_path,s.name) title,cu.content content,s.name sourceName,s.source_uri sourceUri, cu.page_no pageNo,cu.heading_path headingPath,NULL status,cu.content_hash contentHash,COALESCE(CAST(s.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]') permissionTags, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.content_unit_id=cu.id ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceCode,cu.content_hash evidenceHash FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CARD:',c.knowledge_code),c.knowledge_code,'CARD',c.knowledge_base_id,NULL,NULL, c.title,COALESCE(c.content,c.summary),'知识卡片','',NULL,'',c.status, SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',c.knowledge_code,COALESCE(c.title,''),COALESCE(c.content,c.summary,''),COALESCE(c.status,''),COALESCE(c.version,0)),256),COALESCE(CAST(c.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]') permissionTags, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_knowledge_evidence k JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=k.evidence_id WHERE k.knowledge_code=c.knowledge_code ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceCode, (SELECT COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') FROM t_knowledge_evidence k JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=k.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE k.knowledge_code=c.knowledge_code ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceHash FROM t_knowledge_card c WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CLAIM:',cl.claim_code),cl.claim_code,'CLAIM',cl.knowledge_base_id,NULL,NULL, CONCAT('断言：',COALESCE(cl.subject,'')),CONCAT_WS(' ',COALESCE(cl.subject,''),COALESCE(cl.predicate,''),COALESCE(cl.object_value,'')), '断言','',NULL,'',cl.status, SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',cl.claim_code,COALESCE(cl.subject,''),COALESCE(cl.predicate,''),COALESCE(cl.object_value,''),COALESCE(cl.status,'')),256),COALESCE(CAST(cl.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]') permissionTags, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_claim_evidence ce JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id WHERE ce.claim_code=cl.claim_code ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceCode, (SELECT COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') FROM t_claim_evidence ce JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE ce.claim_code=cl.claim_code ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceHash FROM t_claim cl WHERE cl.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND cl.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') ) x ORDER BY objectKey LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_index_delivery_attempt WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox_archive WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_index_delivery_attempt_archive WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox_archive WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
